implementation: Existing contact decision now precedes historical recall for ordinary eligible conversations. Same identity, recent authorized conversation, action authority and stop/work context remain. Unqueried memory is explicit; historical facts use the existing memory action.

Verified bounded provider results can be described by the same contact model without unnecessary deeper work. Home Assistant alone attests its supported partial group result; partial remains failed in the action ledger and never becomes full success.

Light/switch composite actions are directly discoverable. Provider-local resolution handles Dutch compound names and natural word order, with literal actual names taking priority and ambiguity rejected.
Home Assistant group readback checks fresh permitted member states with bounded concurrency. Unavailable members are explicitly uncertain; no automatic repeated effect is introduced.
MCP validation accepts the actual unique intent__ tool alias and enum order variation, retaining exact pinned schema membership and rejecting semantic drift.

Native LOCAL_STOP/capture handoff preserves unadmitted corrections, rebases their generation and waits the existing echo tail before pacing resumed capture. Ordinary speech during output is still gated pending acoustic evidence.
A materialized same-scope continuity CTE avoids repeated retained-work scans; all ownership, retention, destination and stop checks remain.

latencyFindings: Final core preparation measured 829-862 ms with historical recall deferred. The initial greeting baseline preparation was 2822 ms, but overall greeting time did not improve in the observed samples.
One final native light action dispatch and readback took 923.499 ms; two model phases took 3602 and 2986 ms.
A preceding HTTP light sample spent 11588 ms on its first model phase with nearly the same 8k input length. Provider latency varies substantially; this remains outside the speed target.

The continuity query preserves the same ten bindings in a fixed read-only snapshot; measured query 156/166 ms to 48/66 ms, explain execution 279 to 91 ms. delegated_work_runs SeqScan buffer hits fell from 50142 to 274; whole-plan buffer hits were 60106 to 19571. This is query-level evidence, not whole-conversation speed.

Read-only prompt/transport review found fresh per-phase HTTP clients and dynamic instructions preceding stable material, but cache hits and successful handshake stages are not retained. No unmeasured pooling or prompt-order candidate was installed.

remaining: Measure real room interruption and complete follow-up; no assertion of ordinary speech barge-in while the input gate remains.
First model latency remains too slow/variable for the stated voice target; contact routing is installed but fast natural conversation is not accepted.
Acoustic start words, counting cadence and naturalness require the physical observation; neither transcripts nor software playback substitute for it.
